summary: Refresh pending bootstrap receipt after verified adoption upgrade

delivery.outcome: Restore first-allocation eligibility after an already completed published adoption upgrade through an explicit receipt-only verified refresh; ship the material fix in standard0.20.150.
nonGoals: No target source changes or target reports in this hub
No editing or publication grant from a bootstrap receipt
No reset, silent receipt refresh, cleanup or lease takeover

architecture.decision: An explicit --refresh-bootstrap-receipt operation accepts only an already up-to-date published installation. Verify original clone/base, first-allocation state, installed managed closure, unchanged seed bytes and an exactly reversible canonical manifest upgrade; compare the complete target observation again before the single receipt write. Reuse canonical read-only history checks. Fail closed before any write on uncertain provenance.
dataChanges: Ignored bootstrap receipt advances exact installed published pin and hashes; both authority booleans remain false.
architecture.rollback: Reviewed source revert; preserve all existing installed files and failed refresh evidence.

validation.evidence: Real Git migration, published upgrade and receipt-only refresh permit a real first allocation while preserving unrelated bytes.
Changed seeds/manifest, wrong clone/base, malformed receipt, unpublished installation, prior allocations, symlinks and concurrent changes refuse without rewriting receipt or source.
Version150 projections and full native gates pass before independent protected publication.
